description: NaLuP₂O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic P2₁/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.44-2.90 Å. Lu is bonded to six O atoms to form LuO₆ octahedra that share corners with six PO₄ tetrahedra. There are a spread of Lu-O bond distances ranging from 2.10-2.21 Å. There are two inequivalent P sites. In the first P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent LuO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 14-52°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.60 Å. In the second P site, P is bonded to four O atoms to form PO₄ tetrahedra that share corners with three equivalent LuO₆ octahedra and  a cornercorner with one PO₄ tetrahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 27-47°. There are a spread of P-O bond distances ranging from 1.50-1.61 Å. There are seven inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one P atom. In the second O site, O is bonded in a bent 150 degrees geometry to one Lu and one P atom. In the third O site, O is bonded in a bent 120 degrees geometry to two P atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a linear geometry to one Lu and one P atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one Lu, and one P atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one P atom. In the seventh O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, one Lu, and one P atom.
